No artificial additives. No fake fillers. No synthetic sugars. Because performance never needed them.

Finally, you don’t have to choose fake to go far.
Nature had all an athlete needs, all along.

Max energy. Max miles.

More natural energy means more natural endurance. 45g dual-source carbs — from fast-acting glucose and long-lasting fructose — and 220mg sodium — replacing minerals lost during your effort — keep your momentum high.

Elite fuel that travels light.

Leave everything out there but the wrapper.

products.title: Rest & Repair Bundle
products.body_html:
Rest. Repair. Repeat.

Two daily rituals, one complete approach to recovery & restoration. CollagenPro feeds whole-body strength and repair. MagnesiumPro supports rest, relaxation and rebalance. Together they back your body through the work it does after the work is done, so you're ready to go again and again.

Recovery isn't one thing.

The hours between sessions are when your body does its best work: rebuilding connective tissue, restoring what's been used, and rebalancing energy. That needs more than a single nutrient. It needs the raw materials to repair, and the support to rest. This bundle gives you both.

CollagenPro: feel strong, look great, move well.

A pasture-raised bovine collagen powder delivering 10,000mg of pure, hydrolysed type I & III collagen peptides plus organic micronutrients. At 90% protein, each 10g serve provides 9g of clean protein, targeted at rapid repair, recovery and the maintenance of healthy muscles, joints and bones, plus noticeably healthier skin, hair and nails. Naturally flavourless and ultra-fine, it dissolves into any food or drink. Its bespoke BIOVIT™ blend of organic Guava, Lichen and Amla is high in vitamin C and an excellent source of vitamin D and zinc, supporting immunity, cognitive function and reducing fatigue.

MagnesiumPro: fuller rest, stronger recovery.

An advanced 4-in-1 magnesium complex delivering 375mg per daily serving, 100% of your daily magnesium intake, across four high-purity, highly bioavailable forms: Malate for energy production, Glycinate for relaxation and nervous system balance, Taurate for metabolic and cellular function, and Aquamin for electrolyte balance and muscle cramps. Natural botanicals, turmeric, black pepper (BioPerine®) and ginger, combine with a plant-based BIOVIT™ blend of vitamins D3, B6 and B12 to support absorption, energy metabolism and the body's natural recovery processes.

A complete daily ritual.

Stir CollagenPro into your routine to feed whole-body health. Take MagnesiumPro to help your body rest, restore and rebalance. Because there should be no shortcuts, even when you're "doing nothing".

products.title: MagnesiumPro - 4-in-1
products.body_html:
Fuller rest, stronger recovery.

An advanced 4-in-1 magnesium complex, enhanced with natural botanicals and plant-based vitamins, intelligently designed to support relaxation, reduce fatigue and maintain energy — helping your body rest, restore and rebalance, ready to go again and again.

When you stop, your body doesn’t.

In the hours you spend resting — between sessions, after long days and while you sleep — your body is doing its best work: restoring what’s been used, regulating what’s under strain, and rebalancing energy.

MagnesiumPro is built to support that process.

Magnesium plays a role in over 300 bodily functions, influencing everything from energy production and nervous system balance to muscle function and recovery. Yet many magnesium supplements rely on just one form, limiting how effectively they support the body.

MagnesiumPro combines four high-purity, highly bioavailable forms into one advanced 375mg daily serving — delivering 100% of your daily magnesium intake:

  • Malate supports energy production
  • Glycinate supports relaxation and nervous system balance
  • Taurate supports metabolic and cellular function
  • Aquamin supports electrolyte balance and muscle cramps

But MagnesiumPro goes beyond magnesium alone.

Natural botanical extracts — turmeric, black pepper (BioPerine®) and ginger — are combined with a plant-based BIOVIT™ blend of vitamins D3, B6 and B12 to improve absorption, energy metabolism and the body’s natural recovery processes.

Together, they deliver a more complete approach to recovery, energy, balance and restful sleep — going beyond typical single-form magnesium supplements to support how your body actually works.

Because there should be no shortcuts — even when you’re “doing nothing”.

products.title: How To Reduce DOMS Guide
products.body_html:
DOMS Guide: How to Prevent & Relieve Muscle Soreness

Whether you’re new to exercise or pushing your limits with intense sessions, this easy-to-follow guide breaks down exactly how to minimise soreness and maximise performance. Inside, you’ll discover proven strategies to prevent DOMS before it starts—from gradual training progression and effective warm-ups to smart recovery planning.

Clear, practical, and packed with expert insights, this guide empowers you to stay active, recover efficiently, and keep moving forward—without being slowed down by soreness.

72 mixed items designed to help you train towards your Marathon

Sustained Performance, Zero Slumps 🏃

Every stride you take taps into your body’s energy stores, and for runners, that energy comes primarily from carbohydrates. But the quality of those carbs matters. Real-food sources deliver steady, sustained energy without the spikes and crashes, while providing the natural nutrients your body needs to perform at its best. That’s why our energy gels pack 22g of natural carbs, and our energy chews deliver 42g, giving you the fuel you need to go the distance and finish strong.


Deep Hydration & Rapid Replenishment💧

Running takes more than just water. Replacing the electrolytes you lose through sweat helps keep your body in balance, supports strong muscle function, and keeps your mind feeling sharp, so you can move smoothly, mile after mile. Every Veloforte energy gel is Informed Sport Certified and provides 110mg of sodium per pack, while our all-natural Electrolyte Powders are made with real freeze-dried fruit and the purest mineral salts, delivering up to 350mg sodium and 240mg potassium per sachet.


Flavours You Won’t Tire Of 😊

Marathon training is challenging, your nutrition doesn’t need to be. When your fuel tastes great, it’s easier to keep topping up on the energy and key nutrients your body needs to feel strong and run well. The Veloforte Marathon Training Bundle makes it simple to mix things up, with 15 delicious flavours across our chews, gels, protein bars, electrolytes, and protein powders, every sip and bite stays fresh, enjoyable, and easy to stick with all the way to the finish.

Stronger, for longer
